name: workwork
description: Connect an optional agent to your WorkWork profile, review requests, and chat with matches.

interface.shortDescription: Connect an optional agent to your WorkWork profile and chats.
interface.longDescription: WorkWork is an invite-only network where members complete a profile on the website and WorkWork can check requests for them. This optional plugin connects an external agent to edit a profile, review requests and chats, and run matching when the member explicitly transfers that responsibility. The connection uses OAuth-protected MCP tools.
defaultPrompt: Set up my WorkWork agent and turn on hourly checks.
Update what my WorkWork agent is looking for.
Check whether my WorkWork agent has new requests to answer.
Review suggested sources for my WorkWork agent.
